_about: The wording of every scripted skill run: what appears in a chat when a skill runs, and the Example output on a skill's page. There is no model. The app fills the words in curly brackets from the dummy data in src/data/, so the names and numbers always match the rest of the prototype. Each block below belongs to the skill named in its key.
missing: This skill is no longer in your library, so it could not run. Skills you write last until the page is reloaded.
generic: Ran **{skill}** on {input}. Custom skills have no scripted answer in this prototype, so here is the output format the skill asks for:
genericNoFormat: Ran **{skill}** on {input}. Custom skills have no scripted answer in this prototype, and this one has no output format written yet.

notJudged.one: {names} has no stack data on record, so it was not judged.
notJudged.other: {names} have no stack data on record, so they were not judged.

lead.zero: No holdouts: every ECC account shows an S/4HANA signal somewhere on record.
lead.one: **1 holdout** of {total} companies: on SAP ECC with no S/4HANA signal anywhere on record.
lead.other: **{n} holdouts** of {total} companies: on SAP ECC with no S/4HANA signal anywhere on record.

ecc-holdout-finder._momentumFloorAbout: Rising S/4HANA mentions only count as a signal once the latest period has at least this many. One stray mention is noise.

pre-rfp-detector.none: **No LeanIX or Signavio adoption on record** across the {total} accounts. Nothing has been flagged.
pre-rfp-detector.noNearest: No accounts are in the Evaluating phase either.

job-post-decoder.none: No postings on record for {company}, so the phase is **Unclassified**. Nothing was guessed from other signals.

account-brief.noPhaseNote: There is not enough evidence to explain the phase yet.

rise-risk-check.flagged: **RISE with SAP presence found at {company}.** Treat it as a negative signal: SAP is already shaping the programme.
rise-risk-check.absent: **No RISE with SAP commitment on record at {company}.** Not a negative signal.
rise-risk-check.notJudged: **Nothing on record about RISE** at {company}, so it was not judged.

buying-committee-map._seatsAbout: The seats, in order. A contact fills the first seat whose match words appear in their title. standIn words fill the seat only when no match is found, and the line says so.
buying-committee-map.noContacts: No contacts on record at {company}, so every seat is open.

partner-of-record-check._phrasesAbout: A line on record that contains an open phrase counts as the seat being open; one that contains an engaged phrase, and no open phrase, counts as a partner engaged.
partner-of-record-check.engaged: **Partner engaged.** A systems integrator is already named at {company}.
partner-of-record-check.engagedOpening: The record does not say which firm. The opening is scope expansion or a second opinion, not the programme.
partner-of-record-check.open: **Seat open.** No partner has been named at {company}.
partner-of-record-check.openOpening: The partner decision is still to be made. Get in before the shortlist forms.
partner-of-record-check.unknown: **Not judged.** Nothing on record says whether a partner is engaged at {company}.

signal-based-first-touch.toNobody: To: no contact on record yet
signal-based-first-touch.subject: Subject: A question on {company}'s next step
signal-based-first-touch.decision: At the {phase} stage that usually means deciding {decision}.

decisions.latent: whether a programme is worth scoping at all
decisions.evaluating: what the business case has to prove
decisions.mobilizing: who runs the build before the partner seat closes
decisions.executing: how to keep scope from slipping mid-build
decisions.landed: who supports the platform after go-live
decisions.re-expanding: how wave two reuses the first template

signal-based-first-touch.ask: We help teams make that call with evidence, not slides. Worth 20 minutes next week?
signal-based-first-touch.words: {n} words, under the 80 word limit. Opens with the signal, not a compliment.
signal-based-first-touch.over: {n} words, over the 80 word limit. Trim it before sending.
signal-based-first-touch.noSignals: No signals have fired at {company}, so there is nothing true to open with. Run Account brief first.

latent: What would have to break for the ERP to become a board topic?
Who owns the system roadmap today?
When does your current support contract next come up?
evaluating: What does the business case have to prove, and to whom?
Which options are on the table besides a full migration?
When do you expect a decision on whether to go?
mobilizing: Who is choosing the implementation partner, and by when?
What did the last programme teach you about partners?
executing: Where is the build furthest behind plan?
Which scope was cut that you still need?
How are you staffing data migration?
landed: What has hypercare surfaced that the plan missed?
Who owns the platform once the partner rolls off?
Which sites or entities are still on the old system?
re-expanding: Which entities are in wave two, and when?
How much of the first template carries over?
Is the wave one partner doing wave two?
unclassified: What are you running for finance and supply chain today?
Is anything on the system roadmap for the next two years?
Who should we be talking to about it?

lead.zero: No new postings in the last seven days.
lead.one: **1 new posting** across 1 account in the last seven days.
lead.other: **{n} new postings** across {accounts} accounts in the last seven days.

weekly-signal-digest.noAct: No accounts are Mobilizing right now.

campaign-review.numbers: {contacted} accounts contacted and {replied} replied: a reply rate of **{rate}**.
campaign-review.nothingSent: Nothing has been sent yet, so there is no reply rate.

next.interested: **{contact}** at {company} is interested. Book the meeting.
next.unclear: **{contact}** at {company} sent a reply that needs review. Read it and classify it.
next.not_interested: **{contact}** at {company} is not interested. Leave them out of the next campaign.
next.ooo: **{contact}** at {company} is out of office. Follow up when they are back.

campaign-review.noReplies: No replies yet. Check again after the next step goes out.
